author.name: シンタロウ｜非エンジニアのAI実測

summary_md: **シンタロウ｜非エンジニアのAI実測 ([@s_kashiwakura](https://x.com/s_kashiwakura/status/2115948679286956047))** points to a Claude Code issue measuring that background `agent_summary` calls resend full history roughly every 30 seconds per subagent, making up 22.7% (another user: 26%) of requests with no official off switch; he found 10 agent_summary references and 2 timers in 2.1.310 ([issue #86879](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/86879)).

referenced_urls.title: Feature request: a supported way to disable the agent_summary spinner (22.7% of requests, ~18% of weighted tokens in a subagent-heavy session) · Issue #86879 · anthropics/claude-code
